the delete of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 takes 5 nodes a read of the tree returns now, and expected_count names 4: what stands under it has changed since the count was read, so nothing was deleted; read the count again (dry_run=true) and confirm it
a delete names the count it confirms in expected_count: read it first with dry_run=true, then send it, so the delete takes that count or nothing

the delete of dispatch://<issue>/artifact/verification-md#b-c1 would take the result result/<result>, and a result is retracted, never deleted (POST /api/v1/results/{id}/retract): retract it first, or delete what stands under dispatch://<issue>/artifact/verification-md#b-c1 alone; nothing was deleted

the delete of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s1 would take the result result/<result>, and a result is retracted, never deleted (POST /api/v1/results/{id}/retract): retract it first, or delete what stands under dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s1 alone; nothing was deleted

the comment dispatch://<issue>/comment/<comment-on-statement-3> is not deleted through this route: a comment and a message are another writer's words, which their author edits or deletes, so it has a route of its own
the ask dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-q1 is not deleted through this route: an ask keeps its block, its state and its answer, and closes through the ask's own routes, so it has a route of its own

the requirement dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 stands at placement_seq <seq:statement-3@3>, which no If-Match tag names: its parent has changed since it was read, so nothing was deleted; read the tree and delete it again
a delete states the placement it read: send If-Match with the placement_seq of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 as a quoted entity tag, as the tree read answers it

body.error: the :::ask block dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-q1, "Which edits does the graph take?", is a person's decision, and an agent cannot move it: a person moves it, or an agent acting under a token that holds the person scope

the move of dispatch://<issue>/artifact/tree#b-<list-paragraph> would leave the list item <issue>/tree#<list-item> with no block of its own: the move takes the block that a list item "<list-item>" holds as its own first paragraph out of it, which would leave it no first paragraph of its own; nothing was moved, and the list item itself moves or goes whole

Session <worker> cannot write the requirement dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 of <issue>. Legion runs <issue>. Only a person or an architect of <issue> or of an issue above it can write the requirement dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 of <issue>. Session <worker> is the implementer of <issue>. Dispatch records these architects on <issue> and above it: session <architect> on <issue>. Propose the change with a suggestion or a comment.

the move of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s1 under dispatch://<issue>/artifact/verification-md#b-c1 would make a cycle: dispatch://<issue>/artifact/verification-md#b-c1 stands in the subtree of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s1, so it cannot hold it

after "<check-agent>": it is no ranked child of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-k1: after names a node that holds a rank and stands under the parent the moved node has once the move is taken, so nothing was moved

the constraint dispatch://constraint/<constraint> may not stand under dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3, a requirement: a constraint stands only under an issue node, the issue whose constraints list it, and under any other node it would stand under no issue
a move names parent, the node to stand under, after, the ranked sibling to follow, or both; this body names neither
the block <statement-3> is gone: no write writes on it

the comment dispatch://<issue>/comment/<comment-on-statement-3> does not move: its part_of follows its own row - an ask's the document that holds its block, a comment's and a message's what each answers or the node its anchor is on - so a move would leave a difference no pass clears, and the next restore would undo it; an ask moves with the block that holds it
no node "<done-statement>" under <issue>

the move of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s2 under dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-k1 met a node under an issue it had not locked at each of 2 attempts while this request waited for its locks, so nothing was moved: read the tree and move it again

the paragraph dispatch://<issue>/artifact/tree#b-<prose-under-criterion> may not stand under dispatch://<issue>/artifact/notes-u-md, which is or stands under the node of the document <issue>/notes-u-md, a document a removal could take: a removal of the document would leave it live behind no row, and only a lens whose subtree holds lenses, findings and risks alone stands there, so nothing was moved

the move of dispatch://<issue>/artifact/tree#b-<prose-under-criterion> under <statement-3> is refused: the walk of <issue> does not reach <statement-3>, because it is gone, so the moved node would stand where no read answers it; nothing was moved

the requirement dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 stands at placement_seq <seq:statement-3@3>, which no If-Match tag names: its parent has changed since it was read, so nothing was moved; read the tree and move it again
a move states the placement it read: send If-Match with the placement_seq of dispatch://<issue>/spec#b-s3 as a quoted entity tag, as the tree read answers it
